text: 在8月28日的2026年中期业绩发布会上，中国人寿副总裁刘晖表示，公司近20年平均投资收益率达5.15%。上半年，公司总投资收益达3145.04亿元，总投资收益率5.58%，较上年同期上升229个基点；三年平均总投资收益率为4.76%。（上证报）
text_en: At the 2026 interim results conference on August 28, China Life Vice President Liu Hui said the company's average investment return over the past 20 years was 5.15%. In the first half, total investment income reached 314.504 billion yuan, with a total investment return rate of 5.58%, up 229 basis points year-on-year; the three-year average total investment return rate was 4.76%. (Shanghai Securities News)
